CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Psalm of David.
CHAPTER.VERS: Ascribe unto Jehovah, O you sons of God, ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due His name; bow down before Jehovah in the beauty of holiness.
The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters; the Mighty God of Glory thunders; Jehovah is over many waters.
The voice of Jehovah is powerful, the voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.
The voice of Jehovah breaks the cedars; yea, Jehovah shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
He also makes them skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young oryx.
The voice of Jehovah cleaves the flames of fire.
The voice of Jehovah shakes the wilderness; Jehovah shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of Jehovah causes the deer to give birth, and lays bare the forests; and in His temple they all say, Glory!
Jehovah has dwelt at the Flood; yea, Jehovah remains as King forever.
Jehovah will give strength to His people; Jehovah will bless His people with peace.
